sn15.4:1.3: pubbākoṭi na paññāyati avijjānīvaraṇānaṃ sattānaṃ taṇhāsaṃyojanānaṃ sandhāvataṃ saṃsarataṃ || || 3
sn15.4:1.4: Taṃ kiṃ maññatha bhikkhave || || Katamaṃ nu kho bahutaraṃ || yaṃ vā vo iminā dīghena addhunā sandhāvataṃ saṃsarataṃ mātuthaññam pītam yaṃ vā catūsu mahāsamuddesu udakanti || || 4
sn15.4:1.5: Yathā kho mayam bhante Bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitam ājānāma || etad eva bhante bahutaram yaṃ no iminā dīghena addhunāsandhāvatam saṃsarataṃ mātuthaññaṃ pītam || na tveva catūsu mahāsamuddesu udakanti || || 5
sn15.4:2.1: Sādhu sādhu bhikkhave sādhu kho me tumhe bhikkhave evaṃ dhammaṃ desitam ājānātha || || 6
sn15.4:2.2: Etad eva bhikkhave bahutaram yaṃ vo iminā dīghena addhunā sandhāvataṃ saṃsarataṃ mātuthaññam pītam || na tveva catūsu mahāsamuddesu udakaṃ || || 7
